create_lvis_category_lookup: create a function that looks up LVIS categories by ID from LVIS_CATEGORIES list
filter_lvis_rare_categories: filter LVIS_CATEGORIES to return only rare frequency ('r') category entries
build_lvis_name_synonym_map: build a dictionary mapping each LVIS category name to its list of synonyms
summarize_lvis_frequency_distribution: summarize the distribution of frequency values (r, c, f) across LVIS_CATEGORIES
create_lvis_id_to_name_mapping: create a mapping from LVIS category IDs to their canonical names
